ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’)
ἐπέδωκε: ἐπιδίδωμι — give in addition; aor. 3 sg. act. (κ-aorist): ’gave besides’
ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπεπείθεθ: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., elided (ἐπεπείθεθ’ = ἐπεπείθετο; Attic ἐπείθετο)
ἐπετέλλετο: ἐπιτέλλομαι — charge, give orders to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’gave his charge’
ἐπιβήμεναι: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐπιβῆναι)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’)
ἐριτίμοιο: ἐρίτιμος — much-honoured, precious; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with χρυσοῖο
ἐϋκτιμένην: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; fem. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ); said of a town
ἐϋσσέλμους: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (of ships); adj. of two endings, acc. pl., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκὰς: ἑκάς — far, far off; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’far from’
ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑτέροιο: ἕτερος — the other (of two); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with a noun: ’the other’
ἑταίρῳ: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. sg.
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ὀνείαθ’
ἑῇ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive; epic ἑός) — his own, her own; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a fem. noun: ’own’
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔα (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’
ἔθεντο: τίθημι — put, set; mid. make for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’made for themselves’ (οἰκία ἔθεντο ’made their homes’)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause: ’(whoever) might come’ · also after ὁππότε in past sequence, of an awaited event: ’should come’ (ποτιδέγμενοι ὁππότ’ ἄρ’ ἔλθοι ’waiting for when he should come’)
ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); masc. acc. sg., object of ἕντο with ἐξ: ’put away desire’
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’ · also of a feeling, ’seized, gripped’ (θάμβος … ἔχεν ’wonder held (them)’)
ἔχευε: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (contrast unaugmented χεῦεν/χεῦον of the same verb): ’poured’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἔωσιν: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 pl., epic ἔωσιν (= Attic ὦσιν)
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλοις: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you could take’
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ (ἐξ … ἕντο): ’they put away (desire)’
ἕπτ: ἑπτά — seven; indeclinable numeral, elided (ἕπτ’ = ἑπτά)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμαθόεντος: ἠμαθόεις — sandy (epithet of Pylos); masc. gen. sg.
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; fem. acc. sg., with ὑπό: ’beneath the dawn’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ τ’ ἠέλιόν τε ’under dawn and sun’)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰδυίας: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic (= Attic εἰδυίας): ’skilled in’
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἰφιάνασσα: Ἰφιάνασσα — Iphianassa, a daughter of Agamemnon; fem. nom. sg.
ἱκοίμεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. opt. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἱκοίμεθ’ = ἱκοίμεθα), in a condition after εἰ κεν: ’we should come to’
ἱπποβότοιο: ἱππόβοτος — horse-pasturing, breeding horses; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with a place-name: ’horse-pasturing (Argos)’
ἱρὴν: ἱερός (epic ἱρός) — holy, sacred; fem. acc. sg., epic ἱρήν (= Attic ἱεράν) · also Ἱρή — Hire, a town; fem. acc. sg. (proper name)
ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they put out’
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’ · also masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’equal (to)’ (ὃν ἶσον ἐτίομεν ’whom we honoured as equal’)
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic Ὀδυσσῆος (double σ, metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
ὀρέστῃ: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, son of Agamemnon; masc. dat. sg., after ἶσον ’equal to’
ὁμοῖον: ὅμοιος — like, similar; neut. nom. sg., predicate (epic ὁμοῖος = Attic ὅμοιος): ’alike’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’) · also ’how’ in an indirect question + subj. (ὅπως … γένηται ’how … may come about’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
ὅσσά: ὅσος — as great, as many as; neut. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὅσα): ’as many as’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of its verb: ’whatever’ (ὅσσά κεν αὐτοὶ δῶσιν ’whatever they themselves may give’) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with its noun: ’as many (prizes) as’ (ὅσσά … ἀέθλια)
ὑπέρθυμοι: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, high-hearted; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
